design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and functional. Expose the skeleton of the UI using the 'Grid Borders / Technical Look' micro-theme. Use high-contrast accents sparingly to denote status (Pass/Fail/Warn), keeping the rest of the UI monochrome to reduce cognitive load during developer sessions. Avoid soft shadows; rely on 1px solid borders and high-contrast typography.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense and compact for data, generous padding for containers. Mobile-first grid.
layout_patterns: MODE B: THE 'CONTROL ROOM' GRID for the Dashboard (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4)
GRID BORDERS: Containers use border-collapse style layouts with visible 1px borders dividing items.
Centered minimal card for Login view, utilizing raw grid background pattern via CSS.

components.buttons: Flat design, 1px border. Hover state MUST explicitly change background and text color. Focus state MUST have 2px offset ring.
components.cards: Solid background (#121214) with 1px border (border-white/10). No soft shadows. Sharp or 2px max border radius.
components.navigation: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Z-index 50.
components.status_badges: High-contrast text on very dark tinted backgrounds (e.g., text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-400/10 border border-emerald-400/20).
components.tables: Dense. 1px border on bottom of rows. Monospace font for commit hashes, times, and IDs.
components.terminal_log: Retro-Futurism 'Terminal' look. Background #050505. Border border-white/10. Monospace font. Subtle green or white text for logs.

animations.hover: Fast transitions (150ms ease). Target transform and background-color.
animations.loading: Use ASCII or raw monospace loading spinners (e.g., [ / ], [ - ], [ \ ]) instead of smooth circles, or a highly rigid segmented progress bar.
animations.progress_bar: Segmented or glowing line (The 'Tracing Beam' style) for the Live Run state.

icons_and_media.rules: Icons should be sized consistently (w-4 h-4 for inline, w-5 h-5 for actions). Stroke width 1.5 for a technical look.

login_background.description: Use CSS-only abstract grid background instead of an image. Example: radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 0%, #0A0A0A 100%), linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px) with background-size of 24px 24px.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text, especially in terminal logs and badges, meets WCAG AA 4.5:1.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., 'github-login-button', 'repo-select-card', 'live-run-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Install 'lucide-react' and 'react-icons' for the GitHub logo.
Configure Tailwind with the exact color variables provided in the design guidelines.
Do NOT use soft drop shadows (shadow-md, shadow-lg). Instead, use flat UI with 1px borders (border-white/10) to separate elements.
For the login page background, implement the CSS grid pattern as described in 'login_background' description.
The Dashboard View must follow the 'CONTROL ROOM' grid layout logic.
For the Live Run log area, strictly use the JetBrains Mono font, a #050505 background, and ensure new log entries scroll into view automatically.
Use .jsx or .js extension for React files as requested by the user, NOT .tsx.
